integrity: The result gives exact formulas and analytical proofs for the stated scope. Finite program checks complement but do not certify the infinite-step theorems. The prior observation that a global relaxation scalar can couple independent oscillators is credited as established.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic, fixed positive base step, finitely many positive-frequency independent rotations, one global quadratic-norm relaxation scalar, and explicit midpoint. Nonlinear, variable-step, individually relaxed and stochastic schemes are not covered; numerical checks are finite. Small-step convergence is local in rescaled time, and originality is best-knowledge, not independently certified.
title: Spectral energy condensation in norm-relaxed midpoint integration
